        "The original modal-close selector excluded hidden elements. Current .button[hidden] and later .button.modal-close-button have equal specificity and opposing display values; the current hidden Account Hub placeholder uses the modifier. This remains a scoped static cascade concern: other styles were not exhaustively traced and rendered visibility was not tested.",
        "The shortcut control is a native type=button with a Fluent title and decorative empty-alt icon. Its click and dialog-cancel paths reach close/onBeforeClosing and respect #isBusy.         "The fixed-size shortcut dialog gives scrolling to main inside auto/1fr/auto grid rows, with outer overflow hidden. The original repeated headings were an intentional scroll fixture. Reviewer suggested a temporary tall element; author explicitly declined because the fixture would soon be removed. A Done badge does not mean that proposal was applied: the landing retains the headings, while the fixed accepted template has an empty main and controller adds a placeholder row.",
        "The review requested documentation of new widget classes in Storybook, and the landing adds round icon and modal-close examples. A separate reusable Modal component remained a follow-up proposal. This does not establish a rule that every modal must have the same fixed dimensions."

        "Full two-path landing formats the selected notification URL with Services.urlFormatter.formatURL before direct external opening. It updates the original external-protocol stub to compare uri.spec with expectedURI and adds a %LOCALE% CTA test with interaction, clear and request event waits.",
        "At the fixed accepted revision NotificationManager.executeNotificationCTA validates the selected ID, emits interaction, awaits NotificationOpener.openLink, then records interaction, clears selection and schedules another notification. NotificationOpener owns URL formatting before an optional activity wait, then routes the formatted URL externally or into a content tab; cancellation of the activity wait returns without opening.",
        "The visible container independently formats its url attribute before assigning the anchor href and removes href when absent. Its browser test verifies substitution changes the value and compares the displayed href with the formatter result. Display and actual opening remain separate consumers of the notification data.",
        "The fixed accepted manager formatting test still assigns expectedURI, but the inspected task asserts the number of mock opens rather than the exact destination. The original stub assertion and current container href assertion are stronger destination checks for their respective source states. This does not establish absence of destination coverage elsewhere.",
        "Bug discussion requests client substitution for %APP%, %LOCALE%, %VERSION%, %CHANNEL%, %OS% and %APPBUILDID%. The unrelated initialization revision D229994 was explicitly moved to Bug 1933302 and marked obsolete here. ESR uplift is reported in Bug 1936307, not independently audited. D229790 was accepted and closed without actual inline discussion."
